name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.164.0 — red-check's per-file legs quote the test path with single quotes, so a host whose test filenames carry a route parameter (TanStack file routes) no longer has bash expand the segment away and report every passing sanctioned pin as a hard broken-pin; the deviations close refusal now leads with the entry grammar itself — a line is well-formed only as a blank, a heading, a bullet, or an indented continuation of a bullet still open — so a session repairing the sidecar no longer rediscovers the rule by repeated failed marks. 7.163.0 — red-check's file-path leg now single-quotes the path it substitutes into the host testCommand, the same hardening runFilteredLeg already carried: a host whose test filenames embed a route parameter (TanStack file routes, customers.$memberId.note-role.test.tsx) had the segment expanded away by bash, so the leg ran against a nonexistent path and reported a passing sanctioned-green file as a hard broken-pin. The review driver's two deviations-sidecar refusals now state the sidecar's line grammar alongside the malformed lines they name, instead of leaving the rule to be rediscovered by trial. 7.162.0 — Escape rows learn softMatch: a defect the reviewer saw and filed as advisory is now distinguishable from one review never saw, derived from the correlated review artifact's non-hard survivors, validated by the escape-row writer alongside killedMatch, and counted by the fleet reader as escapes.softMatchTrue. review-legs.js gains --replay, which skips the promise-sweep leg only — its sole input is the spec text, which replay's overlay deliberately withholds — so a replay against a spec amended at review reaches a measurement instead of recording setup-failed.
